record.title: Prepare explicit isolated ADB transport readiness before RF epoch reads
record.intent: Resolve the observed offline host transport without retrying device metadata reads.
requirements: Seal and independently review the prerequisite-only ADB offline stop, including absent SCPI/source/settings/RAW operations, recorder statistics and restored host state. Preserve the earlier impedance stop and reviewed remedy unchanged.

Prepare a separate minimal capture adapter which disconnects only the exact isolated peer from the owned local ADB server once, connects that peer once, and observes the local server device list within a bounded deadline before the existing single process-epoch read. Preserve raw connection/status output and stop on timeout, ambiguity or failed connection. Do not restart adbd, invoke root, retry shell reads or change the physical specimen.

Retain the independently accepted stock arm, exact mapping and process checks, current captured lease, host isolation, ordinary impedance normalization/restoration, fixed source schedule, all 75 slots and unchanged numeric/receiver rules. Preserve all predecessor tools and artifacts.

Verify transport readiness with deterministic host-only controls, review exact generated differences and fresh actual bindings independently, and prepare corresponding completed-arm verification without weakening any physical or numerical acceptance rule. No physical operation belongs to this preparation.
acceptance: The isolated transport remedy is independently prepared or a hold is recorded.
